responsibility: This file implements the dynamic-string view of process command-line arguments for the mc-boot runtime. It reads argc/argv from UnixArgs, wraps the nth argv element as a newly allocated DynamicStrings_String, and reports the total count, making it the string-oriented counterpart to the fixed-buffer Args module.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the implementation half of GSArgs: it fetches argc/argv from UnixArgs and wraps selected argv entries as newly allocated DynamicStrings values, while gcc/m2/mc-boot/GSArgs.h only declares that dynamic-string argument interface.
